You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Who carries out the periodic verifications after the first one on the equipment listed in Annex VII?

Facts:
[0] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[1] periodic audits — verifiedBy — The notified body (the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[2] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[3] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.5]
[4] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (ISO? no) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.4]
[5] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[6] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — must use the appropriate verification methods (must use the appropriate verification methods) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.1]
[7] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[8] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.3]
[9] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.4]
[10] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.5]
[11] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.4]
[12] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[13] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall use the appropriate verification methods (shall use the appropriate verification methods) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.1]
[14] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available (ensure that the technical file referred to in annex vii, part a is available) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[15] machinery not referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture (internal checks on the manufacture) [condition: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV] [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[16] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture of machinery (internal checks on the manufacture of machinery) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[17] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance (full quality assurance) [DIR, Annex X]
[18] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — the full quality assurance procedure provided for in Annex X (the full quality assurance procedure provided for in annex x) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[19] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[20] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned; to verify compliance with the requirement of the second paragraph] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.3]
[21] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply the procedure (shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity) [condition: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV] [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[22] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX (the ec type-examination procedure provided for in annex ix) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[23] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[24] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[25] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art (ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art) [DIR, Annex IX]
[26] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (verify that machinery bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[27] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed) [condition: for each type of structure concerned] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.4]
[28] categories of machinery in Annex I Part B — requiresProcedure — one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (one of the procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Annex I, Part B]
[29] categories of machinery listed in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — one of the procedures referred to in Article 12(3) and (4) (one of the procedures referred to in article 12(3) and (4)) [DIR, Annex IV]
[30] operator — hasObligation — have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times (have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[31] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance procedure (full quality assurance procedure) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[32] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — EC type-examination procedure (ec type-examination procedure) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[33] notified bodies monitoring — verifiedBy — Member States (Member States) [DIR, Art. 14(2)]
[34] fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione — hasObligation — dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente (dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente) [condition: qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura] [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[35] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed (shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[36] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (distributors shall verify that) [condition: Before making partly completed machinery available on the market] [REG, Art. 16(2)]
[37] manufacturers — hasObligation — carry out sample testing (carry out sample testing of machinery or related products made available on the market) [condition: When deemed appropriate with regard to the risks presented by machinery or related products] [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[38] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — determine the limits of the machinery (determine the limits of the machinery) [DIR, Annex I]
[39] internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.4]
[40] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[41] safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex ii) [REG, Art. 7(1)]
[42] successive verifiche — verifiedBy — ARPA (ARPA) [condition: ove ciò sia previsto con legge regionale] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[43] Annex I, Part A, point 2 essential requirement — requiresMeasure — Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices (guards for removable mechanical transmission devices) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 2]
[44] manufacturers — hasObligation — carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25 or have it carried out (carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in article 25 or have it carried out) [condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[45] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — must ensure (must ensure) [condition: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[46] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[47] manufacturers — hasObligation — draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 (draw up the eu declaration of conformity in accordance with article 21) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[48] CE marking — hasObligation — must be followed by the identification number of the notified body (must be followed by the identification number of the notified body) [condition: Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied] [DIR, Annex III]
[49] manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 — hasObligation — shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures (shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures) [REG, Art. 25(1)]

response.text: {"kind":"text","value":"Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco, for the Annex VII equipment it owns or has on loan for use; ARPA for successive verifications where regional law provides for it","text":"Under DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis, the periodic verifications of comma 11 on the Annex VII equipment are carried out by the Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco. This applies only to the Annex VII equipment it holds as owner or on loan for use (comodato d'uso). Separately, art. 71, c. 11 names ARPA for the successive verifications where regional law so provides, but the facts do not link that to Annex VII equipment.","used":[0,42]}
